impact: Factory-gate inflation from energy costs adds to global price pressure ahead of US CPI, while soft Chinese demand is a risk for chip and telecom exporters such as SKM and NOK's Asian business.
summary: China's October producer prices rose 5.7% y/y vs 5.3% expected and 5% in September, the fastest since June 2022, led by energy. Consumer prices rose 0.7% vs 0.8% expected, and core CPI slowed to 0.8%, a nine-month low.
title: China October PPI jumps 5.7%, highest since 2022; CPI misses at 0.7%
